description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for performing and displaying the status of a health check against a Supabase backend. It includes a StatefulWidget that checks connectivity by attempting to read from a 'profiles' table and optionally via authentication, displaying the results with UI elements.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flutter widget that performs a network health check against a Supabase backend and displays the status.

classes.name: _HealthCheckState
classes.description: The state class for the HealthCheck widget, managing the check process and UI updates.

methods.name: _runCheck
methods.description: Performs the health check by attempting to read from a 'profiles' table and possibly via auth, updating the UI with results.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Flutter widget UI, showing the status and controls for running the health check.

methods.name: _host
methods.description: Getter that extracts the host portion from the SUPABASE_URL environment variable.
